title: C-dance 2.5 launches continuous 30s shots with 50 #cdance25 #videogeneration #aivideoediting
description: C-dance 2.5 introduced continuous 30-second video generation with full consistency in a single shot. It supports up to 50 reference inputs per generation, allowing for precise scene coherence across faces, products, locations, and audio. The update also features targeted editing, enabling users to fix specific details without regenerating entire videos. This reduces time and computational resources while improving content accuracy. Currently, C-dance 2.5 is accessible within Higgs Field for unlimited use over the next 33 days. #Cdance2_5 #HiggsField #AIvideoEditing #GenerativeAI #VideoGeneration #AIcreativity #DeepLearning #SyntheticMedia #AIVideoTools #ContentCreation #AItechnology
